description: The agent must: (1) Read `data/raw/transactions_2025.csv` containing 10 transaction records. (2) For each record, call or replicate the logic from `scripts/lunar_convert.py` (which uses `zhdate.ZhDate.from_datetime()`) to get the Chinese lunar date. (3) Call or replicate `scripts/number_to_chinese.py` to convert each numeric amount to Chinese financial uppercase using the specific 壹贰叁... digit set with 元/角/分/整 suffixes. (4) Call or replicate `scripts/workday_check.py` which uses a hardcoded override table for 2025 Chinese holidays including the proprietary trap: 2025-09-28 is a *makeup workday* (调休补班) that falls on a Sunday but is classified as 'workday', and dates like 2025-04-05 (清明节) and 2025-06-02 (端午节) are holidays even though they may fall on weekdays. A generic agent relying on standard Python `holidays` library without the custom override table will fail the 调休补班 cases. (5) Output all 10 enhanced records as a JSON array to `financial_report_2025.json`.
